summary.content:
Today's selection covers 55 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 29 on Artificial Intelligence and 11 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Anthropic takes $5B from Amazon and pledges $100B in cloud spending in return
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: The Gentlemen ransomware now uses SystemBC for bot-powered attacks
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from TechCrunch, Dark Reading, The Verge, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek and others
• **Fresh Content**: 34 articles published in the last 24 hours
